original_record.name: ZED
original_record.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one individual game-ready base-pose sprite for a high-detail 2D side-on fighting game, PNG with actual transparent alpha background. Input image is an in-game visual reference ONLY, not the background or camera to copy. Faithfully translate the specific canonical character into clean detailed hand-painted 2D game art with precise contour, believable proportions and crisp readable shading. Subject: ZED from Sega Zombie Revenge, the actual man in the supplied screenshot. Preserve his youthful sharply angular pale face, chin-length straight parted silver-gray hair with long front strands, left golden eye and other brown eye, clean-shaven face, very dark teal-black long tailored coat with broad lapels, dark high-neck shirt and darker patterned necktie, dark matching trousers, belt and dark formal boots. Full figure standing poised in a 3/4 side fighting idle facing right, one nickel/silver Desert Eagle pistol held lowered and left hand relaxed. Preserve the original game clothing silhouette; no armor, no scar, no sunglasses, no invented color panels. Composition: exactly ONE character, all canonical body parts visible, no clipping, centered with 10% transparent margin, eye-level orthographic three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. White-neutral studio light keeps the canonical palette; no scene lighting tint. Transparent everywhere except the character; NO ground plane, pedestal, cast shadow, checkerboard drawn into the image, scenery, UI, bars, text, labels, frame, watermark, other characters or weapon panels. This is a single idle sprite, NOT a sheet or turnaround. Preserve the referenced identity and costume; no redesign.
original_record.limitations: 2D adaptation based on an original in-game screenshot; exact 1:1 fidelity not certified.
